# IFN/OA partial fabrication variant C

RNA-seq in IFN-treated cells showed modulation of both antiviral and matrix genes. IFIT1 was upregulated (Table 2). ISG15 was upregulated (Table 2). OAS1 was upregulated (Table 2). IFIT3 was downregulated (Table 2). MX1 was downregulated (Table 2). OASL was upregulated (Table 2). ACAN was downregulated (Table 2). COL2A1 was downregulated (Table 2).
